title: Hearty Spring German White Beans Casserole
description: A garlicky and springy German dish featuring dried white beans, perfect for meal prep and vegetarian diets. This casserole is a delicious and satisfying option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, bring the vegetable broth to a boil and add the dried white beans, then reduce the heat and let simmer for 45 minutes or until the beans are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked white beans, vegetable mixture, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
